title: 可调整的房间配色预览
prompt: “帮我配一套客厅颜色，我想调整墙面和沙发看看。”
program:
root = Col([intro, tool])
intro = Text("先定墙面，再配沙发。浅墙深沙发最耐看；如果两者都浅，记得用深色地毯或装饰画压一压。下面是示例色卡，可替换成家里实际颜色，预览会即时更新。", "sm", "muted")
tool = Card([Title("客厅配色调整", "md"), preview, sampleNote, Row([Caption("墙面示例色"), Spacer(), Caption(wallName)], 3), wallSwatches, Row([Caption("沙发示例色"), Spacer(), Caption(sofaName)], 3), sofaSwatches, Divider(), summaryRow, advice, resetBtn])
preview = Svg([Rect(0, 0, 240, 116, $wall), Rect(0, 116, 240, 44, "#E8DDCB"), Rect(44, 46, 112, 32, $sofa, null, null, null, 6), Rect(30, 68, 140, 22, $sofa, null, null, null, 5), Rect(22, 60, 18, 38, $sofa, null, null, null, 6), Rect(160, 60, 18, 38, $sofa, null, null, null, 6), Rect(58, 50, 20, 13, "#D9C6B0", null, null, null, 3), Rect(124, 50, 20, 13, "#9FB4A8", null, null, null, 3), Rect(12, 124, 62, 28, "#D9C7A8", null, null, null, 6), Rect(166, 124, 62, 28, "#D9C7A8", null, null, null, 6), SvgText("墙面 " + $wall, 12, 22, 11, "#44403C", "start", "semibold"), SvgText("沙发 " + $sofa, 188, 146, 10, "#44403C", "end", "semibold")], "0 0 240 160")
sampleNote = Caption("示例色卡，用于预览；实际颜色请以涂料或面料色板为准")
wallSwatches = Row(@Each(walls, "w", Pressable([Box([], null, null, null, w.code, "full", $wall == w.code, 36, 36)], @Set($wall, w.code), $wall == w.code, 2)), 2, null, null, true)
sofaSwatches = Row(@Each(sofas, "s", Pressable([Box([], null, null, null, s.code, "full", $sofa == s.code, 36, 36)], @Set($sofa, s.code), $sofa == s.code, 2)), 2, null, null, true)
summaryRow = Row([Box([], null, null, null, $wall, "full", true, 36, 36), Box([], null, null, null, $sofa, "full", true, 36, 36), Col([Text("当前搭配", "xs", "muted"), Text(wallName + " 墙面 · " + sofaName + " 沙发", "sm", null, "medium")], 1), Spacer(), toneBadge], 3)
toneBadge = Badge(strongContrast ? "深浅层次" : bothLight ? "柔和同调" : "温和过渡", "purple")
advice = Text(bothLight ? "墙面和沙发都偏浅，整体会柔和、显大；建议加一块深色地毯、深色抱枕或黑框装饰画，避免缺少重点。" : strongContrast ? "沙发明显比墙面深，层次清楚，这组最耐看；可以再用木色茶几或同色系盖毯做中间衔接。" : "这组有色彩但不会太重，适合温馨客厅；放一盆绿植、一盏藤编灯会更自然。", "sm", "muted")
resetBtn = Button("恢复示例配色", @Reset($wall, $sofa), "ghost", null, "sm")
$wall = "#F5F0E6"
$sofa = "#7D9AA8"
walls = [{code: "#F5F0E6", name: "奶油白", tone: "light"}, {code: "#D9D9D9", name: "浅灰", tone: "light"}, {code: "#B8C4D0", name: "灰蓝", tone: "light"}, {code: "#C7D4C3", name: "豆绿", tone: "light"}, {code: "#D8BFA6", name: "奶茶", tone: "light"}, {code: "#C87E6A", name: "砖红", tone: "mid"}]
sofas = [{code: "#EDE6DB", name: "米白", tone: "light"}, {code: "#B9B9B9", name: "浅灰", tone: "light"}, {code: "#7D9AA8", name: "蓝灰", tone: "mid"}, {code: "#8C6546", name: "棕褐", tone: "dark"}, {code: "#C27A4A", name: "焦糖", tone: "mid"}, {code: "#4F6B52", name: "墨绿", tone: "dark"}]
wallPick = @Find(walls, "code", $wall)
sofaPick = @Find(sofas, "code", $sofa)
wallName = wallPick.name
sofaName = sofaPick.name
wallTone = wallPick.tone
sofaTone = sofaPick.tone
bothLight = wallTone == "light" && sofaTone == "light"
strongContrast = sofaTone == "dark"
